summary: Gregory Cardwell, 52, of Scottsbluff, Nebraska, was killed by a lightning strike near Rainbow Curve while hiking with three companions
location: Rainbow Curve, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Strike occurred about 3:30 p.m. near Rainbow Curve; second lightning fatality in the park in two days. Weather.com reports at least 12 injured and three taken to Estes Park Medical Center; victims=4 reflects Cardwell's party of four.
